rules.lab: PostHog numbers exclude $device_name IN (Pixel 3, OnePlus8Pro) and ILIKE %sdk_gphone% / %simulator% / %emulator%; a NULL $device_name counts as a person (scripts/lib/lab-exclusion.mjs)
rules.person: one PostHog person_id = one install (the app never calls identify())
rules.suppression: a count of installs, users or devices from 1 to 4 is "<5"; an event count is "<5" when its installs are 1 to 4; 0 stays 0
rules.rates: {num, den, value, lowN}: value is null when a side is "<5" or den is 0; lowN = den 5 to 29
rules.days: calendar days in America/Los_Angeles; weeks start on Monday; the calendar sections (active, use, weekly, retention, funnel, content, restore) end at dataThrough (date - 1) and count only events that PostHog received by asOf; card, engagement, health, failures, focus, stores and v1Backend measure at run time (each states its window)
rules.privacy: counts only: no person or device id, email, IP address, reviewer name or user text; no geography (D6)

definitions.people: distinct installs (PostHog person_id) with any event on a production build of active-rollout.json card.builds, from the window start (startedAt) to run time; lab excluded; iPadOS = iOS; an install with no $os_name counts as Android, as the card does. installed = those of them with Application Installed or Application Updated in the window (not store downloads)
definitions.journey: installs on the production builds that reached each step in the window (the union of the step events): Opened = cold_start_began; Past loading = splash_hidden; Logged in = sign_in_succeeded, or onboarding_completed with signed_in = true (a floor: PostHog does not know who is already signed in); Started = playback_started or mushaf_page_opened; Really used = meaningful_listen, mushaf_page_read or playback_completed
definitions.active: distinct installs with any event, all versions, lab excluded, in the trailing 24 hours (dau), 7 days (wau) and 30 days (mau) that end at run time (Today), 1 day before (Yesterday) and 2 days before (Day before)
definitions.usage: event totals, all versions, lab excluded, in the trailing day, week and month at run time: plays = playback_started, heard = meaningful_listen, finished = playback_completed, pages = mushaf_page_opened. Plain integers, not eventCell: each total sums the events of thousands of installs, and the card does not report the installs behind a total
definitions.failures: installs on the production builds with an install or update event, a session of 2 s or more and no screen_content_rendered: "never got in" = no cold_start_began; "stuck on loading" = no splash_hidden
definitions.crashes: the 5 unresolved Sentry issues of level error or fatal with the most users on the production releases (14 days), less active-rollout.json card.suppressIssues. users = the Sentry userCount of the whole issue, all releases: an upper bound for these builds
definitions.anr: play: Google Play user-perceived ANR rate for all v2 versionCodes pooled (day, user-weighted 7d and 28d), as Play publishes it; dailyUsers = Play distinct users on that day (Play rounds it; the card prints it as "~N users/day"). sentry: for Android (ApplicationNotResponding), iOS hangs (App Hanging) and iOS killed (WatchdogTermination), on the last complete UTC day: activeUsers = session users, affectedUsers = users with the error, day = their rate (the card also prints 7d and 28d shares; they have no numerator in the card JSON, so they stay out). appStore: the App Store hang rate of the newest v2 version (s/h). A source that the card prints as "unavailable" (no key) is null; a source that failed is {available: false}; the error text stays out of the data
definitions.ab: the staged build (active-rollout.json build) and its A/B flag, organic devices since startedAt: users = all devices on the build; enrolled = devices with boot_risk_enrolled; the arms count enrolled devices only. byProcessArm counts devices by the arm of the process that died (a device can count under both arms)

data.definition: distinct installs with any event on the LA day (dau), in the 7 LA days ending that day (wau), in the 30 LA days ending that day (mau); rolling windows; any event counts; all versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf; platform = min($os_name) that day, iPadOS = iOS; an install with no $os_name that day counts in total only

for each LA day: the count of each event (events) and the distinct installs that sent it (installs); last30d: the same over the 30 LA days that end on dataThrough (installs are distinct over the whole window). core = meaningful_listen, mushaf_page_read and playback_completed (rollout-engagement coreValueEvents). All versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf; an event count is "<5" when 1 to 4 installs sent it

definitions.week: an LA calendar week, Monday to Sunday; the last week ends at `through`; partialLastWeek = the Monday of that week when it is partial (through is not a Sunday), else null; a partial week holds fewer days, so do not compare it with a full week
definitions.newInstalls: installs whose first organic event (any event) falls in the week
definitions.wau: distinct installs with any event in the week
definitions.listeners: distinct installs that sent meaningful_listen in the week
definitions.playbackStarted: playback_started count ("<5" when 1 to 4 installs sent it)
definitions.pagesRead: mushaf_page_read count ("<5" when 1 to 4 installs sent it)
definitions.completed: playback_completed count ("<5" when 1 to 4 installs sent it)
definitions.byPlatform: the platform of the install: the first $os_name it sent; iPadOS counts as iOS; no $os_name = unknown
definitions.splits: byOsMajor, byMaker, byBuild: newInstalls by the value at first seen (the first event that carries it); listeners by the value of the install's last meaningful_listen in the week. The top 8 by newInstalls + listeners over all weeks keep a row; the rest, and unknown, are "other"
definitions.maker: $device_manufacturer, case folded, without a "Mobile Limited" suffix
definitions.scope: all versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf; no geography

definitions.cohort: installs whose day 0 (the LA day of the first organic event) falls in the LA week (Monday start)
definitions.d2: active on day 1; mature when the install was first seen 48 hours or more before the end of `through` (the LA midnight after it)
definitions.d7: active on any of days 6, 7 or 8; mature when day 8 <= through
definitions.d28: active on any of days 27, 28 or 29; mature when day 29 <= through
definitions.cameBack2ndDay: active on 2 or more distinct LA days in days 0 to 29; mature when day 29 <= through
definitions.maturity: measured at the end of `through`, never at run time; a share is null until EVERY member of the cohort is mature
definitions.rate: num = retained installs, den = the cohort; active = any organic event on the LA day; all versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf; activity after `through` does not count

definitions.install: one PostHog person_id (the app never calls identify()); all versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf
definitions.all: every install with an organic event from the first organic event to 2026-10-18
definitions.aged30: installs first seen at least 30 days before the end of 2026-10-18: day 0 (the LA day of the first organic event) on or before 2026-09-18
definitions.byPlatform: the first non-null $os_name of the install by timestamp; iPadOS counts as iOS; no $os_name = unknown
definitions.installed: ever sent Application Installed (first organic event: Application Installed 2026-05-06)
definitions.opened: ever sent cold_start_began (first organic event: cold_start_began 2026-06-17)
definitions.pastLoading: ever sent splash_hidden (first organic event: splash_hidden 2026-06-08)
definitions.loggedIn: ever sent sign_in_succeeded (first organic event: sign_in_succeeded 2026-08-12) — a floor: PostHog does not see a sign-in from an older build
definitions.loggedInCardRule: extra row: ever sent sign_in_succeeded, or onboarding_completed with signed_in = true — the Daily card's "logged_in" condition (first organic event: sign_in_succeeded 2026-08-12, onboarding_completed (signed_in) 2026-06-20)
definitions.started: extra row: ever sent playback_started or mushaf_page_opened — the Daily card's "started" condition (first organic event: playback_started 2026-05-06, mushaf_page_opened 2026-05-06)
definitions.reallyUsed: extra row: ever sent meaningful_listen or mushaf_page_read or playback_completed — the Daily card's "used_it" condition (first organic event: meaningful_listen 2026-05-09, mushaf_page_read 2026-05-06, playback_completed 2026-05-18)
definitions.meaningfulListen: extra row: ever sent meaningful_listen (first organic event: meaningful_listen 2026-05-09)
definitions.mushafPageRead: extra row: ever sent mushaf_page_read (first organic event: mushaf_page_read 2026-05-06)
definitions.playbackCompleted: extra row: ever sent playback_completed (first organic event: playback_completed 2026-05-18)
definitions.mau: still monthly active: any event from 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-18 (the 30 LA days that end on through)
definitions.churned: installs with no event in those 30 days (installs - mau)
definitions.firstOrganicEvent: the first LA day on which a non-lab install sent the event (the instrumentation start); an install that was active only before that day cannot reach the step

notes: bookmarks and highlights: notInstrumented — the app sends no analytics event for a bookmark, a note or a highlight (TECH_DEBT #297)
riwayah: 1 rewayah_id value(s) are not in assets/data/catalog.json; they are in "other (not in catalog)"

definitions.windows: last30d = the 30 LA days that end on dataThrough; since3_2_0 = 2026-08-03 (3.2.0 production start, LA) to dataThrough
definitions.installs: distinct installs (one person_id = one install); all versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf
definitions.reciters: meaningful_listen by reciter_id; only reciters of the bundled catalog assets/data/catalog.json (matched on id or slug) get a row, with the catalog's name; every other reciter_id is in the last row "other (not in catalog)" (distinct installs over all of them). The event's reciter_name is never read: it can be free text from a user's own upload. installs = listeners, events = meaningful_listen count
definitions.surahs: meaningful_listen by surah_id (1 to 114; the app sends no surah name); id = the surah number
definitions.finish: rate: num = listeners who also sent playback_completed for the same reciter (or surah) in the window, den = listeners
definitions.riwayah: meaningful_listen by rewayah_id (a recitation id), joined to assets/data/catalog.json (rewayat[].id → name) and counted by name; the Hafs spellings are one row ("Hafs A'n Assem"); "* Translation" rows are translation audio; an id that the catalog does not know goes into "other (not in catalog)" (installs summed over the ids); no finish rate: playback_completed sends no rewayah_id (TECH_DEBT #296)
definitions.mushafPagesRead: mushaf_page_read (the page stayed visible for 15 s or more) by page_number (1 to 604); surah = the surah_id most installs sent with the page
definitions.mushafPagesOpened: mushaf_page_opened by page_number; opening a page is not reading it
definitions.totals: distinct installs and event counts over the whole window (listeners/listens = meaningful_listen, completers/completions = playback_completed, readers/pagesRead = mushaf_page_read, openers/pagesOpened = mushaf_page_opened)
definitions.distinct: the number of distinct values in the window (reciters: catalog reciters only); the lists show the top 50
definitions.rank: by installs, then events; a "<5" row keeps its label, its events and finish are suppressed
definitions.bookmarks: notInstrumented: the app sends no event when a bookmark is added or removed (TECH_DEBT #297)
definitions.highlights: notInstrumented: the app sends no event for a verse highlight or note (TECH_DEBT #297)

definitions.daily: for each LA day: distinct installs that sent the event that day
definitions.totals: from 2026-08-12 (the first organic restore) to through: installs = distinct installs that sent any of the events; events.<name> = distinct installs and the event count
definitions.mergesWithCandidates: v1_restore_merged events with candidate_total > 0 (events) and the installs that sent them
definitions.mergesWithSkips: v1_restore_merged events with any of recitations_skipped_no_slug, recitations_skipped_no_reciter, recitations_skipped_no_rewayat, recitations_skipped_no_surah > 0 (events) and the installs that sent them
definitions.platform: the first non-null $os_name of the install by timestamp over its whole history; iPadOS counts as iOS; no $os_name = unknown
definitions.scope: all versions, lab excluded, events received by asOf; the restore runs only after a QF sign-in

data.definition: rollout-engagement.mjs --json, trailing window at run time. users = organic installs (PostHog person_id, lab excluded) with any event on the build; labUsers = lab installs. activation = matured installs (48 h or more since first seen) that reached meaningful_listen, mushaf_page_read or playback_completed. retention: secondDay = matured installs active on 2 or more days ("came back on a 2nd day"); d7 and d28 as the script defines them (planning/signals-phase1-design.md); null when the script does not send them. share is null when the matured count is below the script threshold. Retention counts activity on the SAME build: an install that updated to a newer build counts as not retained, so read it as "stayed on this build" (a build that users leave by an update reads low). pastSplash = installs with splash_hidden / installs with cold_start_began. core = installs (and events) of each core-value event; "notInstrumented" when the build never sent the event

Sentry Sessions API through release-health.mjs --json, trailing 14 days at run time, all environments, versionCode 500 or more, 50 sessions or more. crashFreeSessionShare and crashFreeUserShare are the shares Sentry computes (0 to 1; the names end in Share, so the small-cell scan does not read a share of 1 as a count). pass = crashFreeSessionShare >= thresholds.session and crashFreeUserShare >= thresholds.user (a null share passes, as in the script)

failures.source: card section + GitHub issue search + docs/operations/triage-state.md

data.definition: each FAILURES row of the card section with its GitHub issues. Crash row: the issues that name the Sentry short id (title or body, whole token). Journey row: the issues that name the failure kind and the build number; none → untracked. fixedIn = the fixed-in:<build> labels of those issues plus the triage-state ledger build. fixByPlatform: true when a fix build is a production build of that platform, or an ancestor of one on the git release line; false when every fix build is above or off the line of every production build; null when git cannot tell (a shallow clone). fixInProduction: true = every platform true; false = every platform false, or no fix recorded; null = not certain, or in production on some platforms only

stores.source: Play Developer Reporting API; App Store Connect analytics reports in the signals bucket
notes: iOS: pending (no "App Sessions Standard" report in the signals bucket yet (Phase 0 copies them daily; Apple publishes the first one 1 to 2 days after the request))

definitions.android: Play Developer Reporting API, crashRateMetricSet distinctUsers by versionCode, DAILY: users who used the app on the day and share usage and diagnostics data with Google. Days are Play days (America/Los_Angeles), as Play dates each row. v1 = versionCode < 1257, v2 = 1257 and up; a line adds its versionCodes (a user who updated that day counts twice). Play rounds the values and publishes no row for a cohort under its privacy threshold (about 50 users): null = no row (under the threshold when the day is on or before publishedThrough; not published yet when after). topVersionCodes: the 5 largest versionCodes of the day.
definitions.ios: App Store Connect analytics reports. "App Sessions Standard" (DAILY): Sessions and Unique Devices for each Date and App Version, opted-in devices only (users who share analytics with developers); v1 = app version < 3.1.0. Devices add the report rows (version x device x OS x territory x source), so a device that changed version or OS that day counts twice. For each Date the rows of the newest report instance are used (Apple: never add two instances). Dates are as Apple gives them. null = no row for the day. installs = Install events except Manual update; firstTimeInstalls = First-time download; manualUpdates = Manual update; deletions = Delete events ("App Store Installation and Deletion Standard", Counts).

ios.note: no "App Sessions Standard" report in the signals bucket yet (Phase 0 copies them daily; Apple publishes the first one 1 to 2 days after the request)

data.definition: v1 backend, for the 7 and 30 LA days ending at dataThrough: playEvents = recitationstatistics documents (one per v1 play report) created in the window; estDevices = their distinct non-empty client IPs (an estimate: an IP is not a device); accountsUpdated = users with updatedAt or updated_at in the window; favouritesAdded = favourites with createdAt or created_at in the window, favouriteUsers = the distinct users who added them. newestSignup / newestFavourite = LA date of the newest users / favourites document created before the end of dataThrough. Counts only.

platforms.source: derived from active, stores and v1Backend; PostHog HogQL for v2 installs
notes: iOS v1: stores iOS part is pending (no "App Sessions Standard" report in the signals bucket yet (Phase 0 copies them daily; Apple publishes the first one 1 to 2 days after the request))

definitions.installsAllTime: distinct v2 installs (PostHog person_id) with any event up to dataThrough (events received by the snapshot asOf), by the first non-empty $os_name of the install; iPadOS = iOS; lab excluded; an install with no $os_name is in neither platform
definitions.mau30: the active section: distinct installs with any event in the 30 LA days ending at dataThrough
definitions.playUsers7dAvg: Android v1 (versionCode < 1257): the mean of Play daily distinct users over the days with a row in the 7 Play days ending at the newest Play day; null = no v1 row in those days (under Play's threshold of about 50 users, not 0)
definitions.ascDevices7dAvg: iOS v1 (app version < 3.1.0): the mean daily unique devices of App Sessions Standard over the days with data in the 7 days ending at the newest report day; opted-in devices only; a mean of daily counts, not 7-day unique devices
definitions.estDevices7d: the v1Backend section: distinct client IPs of v1 play reports in the 7 LA days ending at dataThrough (both platforms; an estimate)

v1.note: stores iOS part is pending (no "App Sessions Standard" report in the signals bucket yet (Phase 0 copies them daily; Apple publishes the first one 1 to 2 days after the request))
Play published no v1 row in the 7 days to 2026-10-15: under its threshold (about 50 users a day), not 0

focus.source: docs/operations/brief-focus.json + Play Reporting API, Sentry, PostHog

definitions.playAnrRate: Google Play userPerceivedAnrRate for each versionCode (Play Developer Reporting API through play-vitals.mjs --json): day = the rate on Play's last published day; d7 and d28 = the daily rates of the 7 and 28 days that end on it, weighted by distinct users (null when fewer than half the days are published); dailyRate = the rate on each LA day of `days` (null = not published)
definitions.playUsers: Google Play distinct users of each versionCode: users = on Play's last published day (Play rounds distinct users); dailyUsers = on each LA day of `days` (null = not published)
definitions.sentryAnrUsers: Sentry, environment production, for each release: anrUsers = distinct users with error.type ApplicationNotResponding on each UTC day of the measure `days`; sessionUsers = distinct session users on that day; weekAnrUsers and weekSessionUsers = distinct users over the last 7 of those days; weekAnrShare = weekAnrUsers / weekSessionUsers
definitions.posthogActive7d: PostHog installs (person_id, lab excluded) with any event on the build: dau = on each LA day of `days`; wau = in the 7 LA days that end on that day
definitions.sentryIssueDaily: Sentry, all environments: users = distinct users of the issue on each UTC day of the measure `days`; events = its events on that day
definitions.abArms: the card section A/B block: the arms count enrolled devices only; anrShare = anrDevices / devices of the arm
